segments.source: captureHighResolutionFrame(completion:)
segments.ko: captureHighResolutionFrame(completion:)

segments.source: **Framework**: ARKit **Kind**: method
segments.ko: **Framework**: ARKit **Kind**: method

segments.source: Requests a frame outside of the normal frequency that contains a high-resolution captured image.
segments.ko: 일반 주기 외부에서 고해상도 캡처 이미지를 포함하는 frame을 요청합니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: iPadOS 16.0+
segments.ko: iPadOS 16.0+

segments.source: Mac Catalyst 16.0+
segments.ko: Mac Catalyst 16.0+

segments.source: Declaration
segments.ko: Declaration

segments.source:
```swift
func captureHighResolutionFrame() async throws -> ARFrame
```
segments.ko:
```swift
func captureHighResolutionFrame() async throws -> ARFrame
```

segments.source: Discussion
segments.ko: Discussion

segments.source: If the function succeeds, the completion handler’s frame contains a high quality, high resolution [`capturedImage`](arframe/capturedimage.md).
segments.ko: This property returns `nil` if you’re not encoding.

segments.source: In the event of failure, the completion block receives a non-`nil` error object.
segments.ko: 실패한 경우 completion block은 `nil`이 아닌 오류 객체를 받습니다.

segments.source: A call may fail if a previous request for a high resolution capture hasn’t completed yet, or an underlying problem occurs in the system’s capture pipeline.
segments.ko: 이전의 고해상도 캡처 요청이 아직 완료되지 않았거나 시스템 캡처 파이프라인에 근본 문제가 발생한 경우 호출이 실패할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: You can identify the failure reason in either case by checking for [`highResolutionFrameCaptureInProgress`](arerror/highresolutionframecaptureinprogress.md) or [`highResolutionFrameCaptureFailed`](arerror/highresolutionframecapturefailed.md), respectively.
segments.ko: 각 경우에 따라 [`highResolutionFrameCaptureInProgress`](arerror/highresolutionframecaptureinprogress.md) 또는 [`highResolutionFrameCaptureFailed`](arerror/highresolutionframecapturefailed.md)를 확인하여 실패 원인을 식별할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: ARKit populates the frame’s properties other than pixel data, including pose information, anchors, and frame semantics.
segments.ko: ARKit은 자세 정보, 앵커, frame semantics를 포함하여 픽셀 데이터 이외의 frame 속성을 채웁니다.

segments.source: The system provides the frame to your completion handler asynchronously.
segments.ko: 시스템은 frame을 completion handler에 비동기적으로 제공합니다.

segments.source: You can call this function at any time during a session.
segments.ko: 세션 중 언제든지 이 함수를 호출할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The system delivers a high-resolution frame out-of-band, which means that it doesn’t affect the other frames that the session receives at a regular interval, such as [`currentFrame`](arsession/currentframe.md) or the frame argument to [`session(_:didUpdate:)`](arsessiondelegate/session(_:didupdate:)-9v2kw.md).
segments.ko: 시스템은 고해상도 frame을 out-of-band로 전달하므로 [`currentFrame`](arsession/currentframe.md) 또는 [`session(_:didUpdate:)`](arsessiondelegate/session(_:didupdate:)-9v2kw.md)의 frame 인수처럼 세션이 정기 간격으로 받는 다른 frame에 영향을 주지 않습니다.

segments.source: For the highest resolution captured image, choose a non-binned [`videoFormat`](arconfiguration/videoformat-swift.property.md) in your session’s configuration.
segments.ko: 최고 해상도 캡처 이미지를 얻으려면 세션 구성에서 non-binned [`videoFormat`](arconfiguration/videoformat-swift.property.md)을 선택하세요.

segments.source: You can call [`recommendedVideoFormatForHighResolutionFrameCapturing`](arconfiguration/recommendedvideoformatforhighresolutionframecapturing.md) to select the best option for you.
segments.ko: [`recommendedVideoFormatForHighResolutionFrameCapturing`](arconfiguration/recommendedvideoformatforhighresolutionframecapturing.md)를 호출해 자신에게 가장 적합한 옵션을 선택할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: For the highest resolution still images, choose a [`videoFormat`](arconfiguration/videoformat-swift.property.md) among your configuration’s [`supportedVideoFormats`](arconfiguration/supportedvideoformats.md) that returns `true` for [`isRecommendedForHighResolutionFrameCapturing`](arconfiguration/videoformat-swift.class/isrecommendedforhighresolutionframecapturing.md).
segments.ko: 최고 해상도의 정지 이미지를 위해서는 구성의 [`supportedVideoFormats`](arconfiguration/supportedvideoformats.md) 중 [`isRecommendedForHighResolutionFrameCapturing`](arconfiguration/videoformat-swift.class/isrecommendedforhighresolutionframecapturing.md)이 `true`를 반환하는 [`videoFormat`](arconfiguration/videoformat-swift.property.md)을 선택합니다.

segments.source: If your app doesn’t have specific resolution requirements, you can use the framework-recommended format that [`recommendedVideoFormatForHighResolutionFrameCapturing`](arconfiguration/recommendedvideoformatforhighresolutionframecapturing.md) returns.
segments.ko: 앱에 특정 해상도 요구 사항이 없다면, [`recommendedVideoFormatForHighResolutionFrameCapturing`](arconfiguration/recommendedvideoformatforhighresolutionframecapturing.md)가 반환하는 프레임워크 권장 형식을 사용할 수 있습니다.

segments.ko: Parameters

segments.source: `completion`: Code you provide that the framework runs after attempting to generate the frame.
segments.ko: `completion`: 프레임 생성 시도 후 프레임워크가 실행하는 코드입니다.
